title: agent-desktop: computer use through the accessibility tree

verify_before_render: Visuals come from the beat plan and the voice's word timings only.

scenes.heading: AGENT-DESKTOP: AI RUNS YOUR PC?
scenes.say: Can an AI agent use my computer for me without guessing from screenshots?

scenes.heading: READS THE ACCESSIBILITY TREE
scenes.say: It reads your apps through the accessibility tree, the same structure screen readers use.

scenes.heading: A REF FOR EVERY ELEMENT
scenes.say: Every element gets a ref, so the agent clicks a target instead of a guessed spot.

scenes.heading: STALE REFS FAIL SAFELY
scenes.say: If the screen changes, an old ref fails safely. Take a new snapshot.

scenes.heading: ONE COMMAND TO INSTALL
scenes.say: Install it with one npm command. The source is open for anyone to read.

scenes.heading: MACOS NEEDS ONE GRANT
scenes.say: On macOS, you grant Accessibility permission first.
Would you let an agent use your desktop? Comment DESKTOP and I'll pin the repo link.
